_disclaimer: Module C, Milestone 3, Section B: predeclared, explicit feature lists for the two baseline logistic regression specifications, frozen BEFORE any model is fit -- no field here was added or removed after looking at validation/benchmark performance. Model A = application-time-safe features only, excluding LendingClub's own lender-assigned risk signals (grade, sub_grade, int_rate). Model B = Model A plus exactly those three fields. Every raw field listed is cross-checked at load time (src/credit_risk/feature_selection.py) against configs/credit_risk_feature_eligibility.json's available_at_application/leakage_concern judgment -- this file does not re-litigate eligibility, only selects a modeling-practical subset of the already-eligibility-cleared fields and the three explicitly-flagged unresolved grade/sub_grade/int_rate fields for Model B only.

exclusions_from_eligible_pool._note: Fields that ARE application-time-safe per credit_risk_feature_eligibility.json but are deliberately excluded from both Model A and Model B, with the reason recorded explicitly so no exclusion is silent.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.id: primary key / join column only, never a model feature (per eligibility config's own proposed_use).
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.url: contains the loan's own id; no independent information (per eligibility config's own proposed_use).
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.issue_d: the point-in-time anchor itself (origination_date), not a feature -- used to derive term_months/credit_history_months_at_application/maturity_date, never fed to the model directly.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.member_id: already excluded at the eligibility-table level (available_at_application='no', 100% NULL in this release).
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.policy_code: near-constant (==1 for virtually every row); carries no discriminative information regardless of timing.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.emp_title: free text, high cardinality; NLP normalization is out of scope for this baseline logistic regression milestone.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.desc: free text; out of scope for this baseline milestone.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.title: free text (borrower-supplied loan title); out of scope for this baseline milestone.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.zip_code: high-cardinality (3-digit prefix, ~900 distinct values) geographic field. addr_state (51 values) is retained as the baseline's geographic control; including zip_code as well would make the Section G coefficient interpretation intractable and add many near-collinear geographic dummies for a baseline model. Candidate for a future, more complex model.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.funded_amnt: empirically near-duplicate of loan_amnt (correlation 0.9998 on the full real file; differs on only 2,065 of 2,260,668 rows) -- including both would split one economic signal across two collinear coefficients and muddy Section G interpretation. loan_amnt (the original request) is kept; funded_amnt (the lender's funding decision) is dropped.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.funded_amnt_inv: same near-duplicate concern as funded_amnt (correlation 0.9990 with loan_amnt) -- dropped for the same reason.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.fico_range_low: superseded by the derived fico_avg_at_application (see derived_features) -- fico_range_low/fico_range_high are perfectly collinear in the real file (correlation 0.99999998; the high-low gap is a constant 4 or 5 points for every row), so keeping both would duplicate one signal across two coefficients.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.fico_range_high: superseded by fico_avg_at_application -- see fico_range_low entry.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.annual_inc_joint: 94.7% NULL, populated only when application_type=='Joint App'. A baseline single impute-and-include treatment would blur the co-applicant signal into application_type rather than meaningfully modeling joint applications; excluded here, flagged as a candidate for a dedicated joint-application sub-model in a future milestone.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.dti_joint: same joint-application sparsity concern as annual_inc_joint -- excluded for the same reason.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.verification_status_joint: same joint-application sparsity concern as annual_inc_joint -- excluded for the same reason.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.revol_bal_joint: same joint-application sparsity concern (~95% NULL) -- excluded for the same reason.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_fico_range_low: secondary/co-applicant bureau field, ~95% NULL, same joint-application sparsity concern as annual_inc_joint.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_fico_range_high: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_earliest_cr_line: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_inq_last_6mths: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_mort_acc: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_open_acc: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_revol_util: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_open_act_il: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_num_rev_accts: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_chargeoff_within_12_mths: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_collections_12_mths_ex_med: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.sec_app_mths_since_last_major_derog: same joint-application sparsity concern as sec_app_fico_range_low.
exclusions_from_eligible_pool.open_acc_6m: empirically 100.00% missing within the primary split's train bucket (2007-06 to 2011-12) -- LendingClub introduced this field in a later vintage. An all-NaN-in-train column, under a train-only-fit imputer, contributes no trainable signal and must not be included (verified by direct query against loans_raw, not assumed).

model_a_derived_numeric_fields.term_months: parsed from the raw `term` string (' 36 months' / ' 60 months'); reuses the same parsing rule as src/credit_risk/target_construction.py's _term_to_months, so the loan-structure feature and the maturity-date-derivation logic never disagree.
model_a_derived_numeric_fields.emp_length_years: mapped from the raw `emp_length` string via an explicit, auditable table (see src/credit_risk/feature_loader.py::EMP_LENGTH_YEARS_MAP): '< 1 year'->0, '1 year'->1, ..., '9 years'->9, '10+ years'->10, missing stays missing (imputed by the leakage-safe preprocessing pipeline, never silently zero-filled here).
model_a_derived_numeric_fields.fico_avg_at_application: mean of fico_range_low and fico_range_high (both available at application; perfectly collinear with each other in the real file, so neither raw column is kept standalone -- see exclusions_from_eligible_pool).
model_a_derived_numeric_fields.credit_history_months_at_application: whole months between earliest_cr_line and issue_d (origination_date). Both inputs are available at application time; this is a derived application-time-safe feature, not a post-origination quantity.

model_b_additional_fields_rationale: These three fields are LendingClub's OWN risk assessment, assigned at/before origination (technically application-time-available) but explicitly flagged 'unknown'/circularity-risk in configs/credit_risk_feature_eligibility.json (UNRESOLVED BY DESIGN, not a timing leak). Model B exists specifically to measure how much predictive lift comes from the lender's own prior underwriting signal (Section H ablation), never to recommend including them in a deployed PD model without further review.
